Focused fixtures model flight=null with an earlier DEFERRED/CANONICAL_UNKNOWN subject and later healthy UNRESOLVED subjects, asserting that only the first eligible later subject is submitted and owns the durable flight.

Focused fixtures assert later RESOLVED_NOOP classification without browser attachment despite an earlier unknown subject, including fresh per-event observation, retained-record dedupe and permanent compaction dedupe.

Pass-local safety blockers preserve their proven reason for later unresolved subjects when flight is absent. Counterexamples cover draft, generation, target/surface, binding and insertion/send blockers while permitting later resolved NOOPs; a production-adapter fixture guards the remaining draft after canonical uncertainty following insertion.

Successful and ambiguous submission paths retain durable flight and serialize later unresolved subjects. Proof-only reconciliation and submission dedupe remain unchanged; strengthened fixtures assert the pre-click flight boundary, single-submission serialization and no resend.

The committed candidate changes only the four permitted files. Both contract documents describe NON_BLOCKING_PER_EVENT_WAKE_V1, keep H4B UNPROVED and assign the unchanged focused suite plus git diff --check to Runtime. Implementation work is complete.
